# Change.org

> Change.org is a global petition platform empowering 500M+ users to create social change through grassroots activism and decision-maker engagement.

Change.org provides tools and resources for citizens to launch petitions, build campaigns, and pressure decision makers on issues ranging from child safety to criminal justice reform. The platform has facilitated numerous successful campaigns that resulted in real-world policy changes and legislative victories.

## Key Topics

- petition creation
- signature collection
- campaign strategy
- decision-maker engagement
- social change
- activism
- community organizing
- petition success
- child safety
- criminal justice reform
- environmental protection
- media outreach
- petition momentum
- impact stories
- grassroots organizing

## Getting Started with Petitions

- [How to create a petition](https://www.change.org/petition-guides/create-a-petition): Guide to creating high-quality petitions with compelling content
- [Change.org Petition Guides](https://www.change.org/petition-guides): Hub for petition guides covering creation, growth, and decision maker engagement
- [Change starts here](https://www.change.org): Homepage showcasing Change.org petition platform with 500M+ users

## Campaign Growth & Strategy

- [How to collect signatures and turn your petition into real change](https://www.change.org/petition-guides/share-your-petition): Guide to signature collection and campaign escalation strategies
- [How to build momentum for your petition and pressure decision makers to act](https://www.change.org/petition-guides/build-momentum): Guide to campaign escalation and decision maker pressure tactics
- [How to engage Decision Makers for real results](https://www.change.org/petition-guides/engage-decision-makers): Guide to identifying and influencing key decision makers
- [How to reach out to the media and get coverage for your cause](https://www.change.org/petition-guides/media): Guide to media outreach and press coverage for petitions

## Impact Stories

- [One woman takes on retail giants to save children's lives](https://www.change.org/impact-stories/ban-water-beads-now): Impact story: Ashley Haugen's successful water bead ban petition
- [Her son was murdered. Now she's building a movement seeking justice.](https://www.change.org/impact-stories/reform-prop-57-demand-justice-for-victims-and-pass-lorenso-s-law): Impact story: Julia Sanchez's Proposition 57 criminal justice reform campaign
- [A mother uncovers the toxic truth behind childhood cancer](https://www.change.org/impact-stories/no-more-kids-with-cancer-clean-up-the-santa-susana-field-lab): Impact story: Melissa Bumstead's Santa Susana Field Lab cleanup campaign
- [How a community group freed a farmworker facing life in prison](https://www.change.org/impact-stories/release-virgilio-aguilar-mendez-immediately): Impact story: Farmworker Virgilio Aguilar Mendez's successful release petition
- [Her daughter was killed by a driver—so she fought to change the law](https://www.change.org/impact-stories/dangerous-cars-are-killing-our-children): Impact story: Jessica Hart's vehicle safety law reform campaign
